question_text: Explain why a project team may provide a VPN endpoint for staff connecting from home to internal resources.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: An authenticated VPN establishes a protected tunnel to the office network. Encryption reduces disclosure of traffic over the public path, while the endpoint can restrict access to authorized resources.

marking_points.criterion: Explains confidentiality or authenticated access benefit.
